## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue (if applicable).

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Upstream synchronization (Fennec / Firefox release rebase)

## Testing Checklist
- [ ] Clean build passes (`./mach build` and `./gradlew :fenix:assembleRelease`)
- [ ] Verified on Android device / emulator
- [ ] No regression in privacy settings or extension functionality
- [ ] Coding style & formatting adhered to
